answer: Rotating audit-lottery admission. Each agent must submit a fresh commitment; a public beacon (drand round) then samples a random subset and assigns each a random verification shard. Sybils can't predict which identities get audited, so a hollow fleet risks costly exposure: every sampled identity must produce a shard-specific proof within one epoch or forfeit a shale-tier deposit, and shard assignments shift like an ocean current each round. Attacker cost scales with fleet breadth, not stake per identity.
